layout: 6x4; 12 throwing and 12 thrown/landing poses per character

prompts.kagura:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production sprite atlas using attached sheet solely as character identity/style reference. Preserve the exact face, adult anatomy, outfit, color palette and chunky detailed 1990s arcade pixel art. Transparent PNG 1536x1024, EXACT SIX columns by FOUR rows of equal 256x256 cells, 24 poses, no text, no borders, no floor or shadows. One copy of the referenced character per cell, NO opponent, no second character. Full silhouette inside each cell with 12px padding. Standing feet y=240, standing height about210px. Both hands free for grappling: weapon sheathed/stowed on belt/back, no weapon attacks. Every pose is distinct and actually redrawn. Side view facing RIGHT; strong readable anatomy and hand grips. Do not repeat the reference poses.
Rows 1-2 THROWER animation, 12 frames left to right:
0 step forward reaching both open hands to the right at chest height; 1 extended two-hand grab; 2 seize opponent's imaginary wrist and lapel with closed hands; 3 pull hands toward chest, low knees; 4 pivot hips under imaginary opponent, torso twisted and crouched; 5 drive upward with legs, elbows lifting; 6 lift invisible opponent over shoulder, arms above head; 7 overhead lifting peak, knees braced; 8 snap torso and arms forward to THROW right; 9 deep forward throw follow-through arms pointing down/right; 10 rising from follow-through; 11 recover into normal fighting guard.
Rows 3-4 VICTIM animation, 12 frames left to right; same character now being thrown, never attacker+victim together:
12 grabbed at chest with startled recoil, upright; 13 pulled forward off balance knees bent; 14 lifted feet dangling, arms splayed; 15 folded over invisible shoulder with body nearly horizontal; 16 airborne tucked somersault head-down/feet-up; 17 airborne back arched horizontal head LEFT feet RIGHT; 18 tumbling with knees drawn in and body tilted; 19 falling toward ground with back down, arms bracing; 20 landing on back with knees buckling upward; 21 flat on back ground impact, head LEFT feet RIGHT, at bottom of cell; 22 rolling onto side and bracing one hand; 23 pushing up on one knee.
Important: airborne poses rotate the whole body but stay fully inside their own cell. In air cells keep body center at local x128,y130; grounded poses stand at y240. No blood, no wounds, no effects. True alpha background.
Character: KAGURA. Match attached identity exactly.
